prose: Marty Leeds the headmaster of the Gnostic Academy of Lord Jesus Christ returns to Vibe Rant alongside friend and neighbor Topher Gardner from BioCharisma. In an informal way, we'll be riffing about the Biblical idea of Christ's millennial reign and how this aspect of scripture lines up with more ancient ideas about the grand cycles of time, aka the world ages. Don't miss this one!
